tips.text: Bank 410 Ducats and 200,000 credits before Baro arrives; his 48-hour window is too short to farm them after.
Buy it the first time it shows up in Baro's stock; it only returns every few months.
Pick the highest-Ducat part on each relic reward screen instead of the one you would keep.
Sell every duplicate Prime part at the Ducat Kiosk.
Run fast Capture or Exterminate fissures on quick tilesets for the quickest Ducats.
Try short Defense, Void Cascade or Void Flood fissures to crack a relic every few minutes without reloading between runs.
Refine relics to Radiant for the best chance at gold Ducat parts.
Bring Mirage to make Defense fissures very fast.
Treat Vericres as a Mastery pickup; recaps call it decent but unremarkable.
